entities.name: Configured NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice selection assistance information configured for the UE. Stored in non-volatile memory and composed of at most 16 S-NSSAIs. Associated with PLMN/SNPN identity and subscriber data.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice selection assistance information allowed for the UE. Stored in non-volatile memory and composed of at most 8 S-NSSAIs. Associated with PLMN/SNPN identity, access type, and subscriber data.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice selection assistance information rejected for the UE. Includes different types: for current PLMN/SNPN, current registration area, failed/revoked NSSAA, and maximum number of UEs reached.

entities.name: Pending NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice selection assistance information pending authorization. Composed of at most 16 S-NSSAIs. Associated with PLMN/SNPN identity and subscriber data.

entities.name: Default configured NSSAI
entities.description: Default network slice selection assistance information configured for the UE. Not deleted when network slicing subscription changes.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single network slice selection assistance information. The basic building block of NSSAIs.

entities.name: NSAG information
entities.description: Network slice assistance group information. Optional information associated with configured NSSAI.

entities.name: NSSRG information
entities.description: Network slice selection routing group information. Optional information associated with configured NSSAI.

entities.name: Timer T3526
entities.description: Timer associated with rejected S-NSSAI for maximum number of UEs reached. Stopped when rejected NSSAI is deleted or updated.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: NAS message that can trigger updates to NSSAI storage, including deletion of allowed NSSAI and rejected NSSAI.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message that can provide new allowed NSSAI, pending NSSAI, or trigger deletion of stored NSSAIs.

entities.name: Non-volatile memory storage
entities.description: Requirement to store configured NSSAI, allowed NSSAI, and associated information in non-volatile memory in the ME.

relations.description: Configured NSSAI is composed of S-NSSAIs (maximum 16).
Allowed NSSAI is composed of S-NSSAIs (maximum 8).
Pending NSSAI is composed of S-NSSAIs (maximum 16).
Configured NSSAI shall be stored in non-volatile memory.
Allowed NSSAI should be stored in non-volatile memory.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND with Registration requested bit can delete stored allowed NSSAI.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND with Registration requested bit can delete stored rejected NSSAI.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message can provide new pending NSSAI or trigger deletion of stored pending NSSAI.
When rejected NSSAI is deleted or updated, timer T3526 associated with rejected S-NSSAI is stopped if running.
Configured NSSAI may have associated NSAG information that is stored in the ME.
Configured NSSAI may have associated NSSRG information that is stored in non-volatile memory.
